entities.summary: Croatian Kingdom, a political institution in Croatia during Ottoman Frontier and Military Border (1493–1593). Grew from Battle of Krbava Field — devastating Croatian defeat by Ottomans. Led to the emergence of Habsburg and Croatian Parliament elects Ferdinand Habsburg as king after Mohács.
